== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Ahch-To: Saddle (ALT)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column; a change of the printed errata mark alone is its own column. The re-made image of 15 January 2022 added the [[Episode VII]] icon at the top of the right border; the 12 December 2022 logo addition ([[Ahch-To: Saddle (ALT) (Errata 2)]]) prints the same words, icons and no mark, so it shares the Errata column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
